opportunities.name: California Arts Council — Impact Projects
opportunities.funder: State of California / California Arts Council
opportunities.cycle: Annual State Cycle (Spring Window / Rolling Planning)
opportunities.deadline: Next Window: March – May 2026 (Priority Prep Now)
opportunities.eligibility: 501(c)(3) California non-profit; operating budget under $3M (Under $250k receives maximum priority weighting); serving lower quartiles of CA Healthy Places Index (HPI).
opportunities.strategicFocus: Community-centered artistic, acoustic, and somatic wellness interventions addressing systemic isolation, racial trauma, and emotional well-being.
opportunities.innerSanctuaryFit: Perfect match for monthly SoCal Creatives Collective Open Mics and Permission to Pause somatic circles. Zero entry fee aligns 100% with CAC equity access mandates.
opportunities.actionRequired: Pre-load project abstract into California Arts Council SmartSimple portal. Budget requested: $20,000.

opportunities.name: CAC Cultural Pathways Capacity Grant
opportunities.eligibility: Small, emerging arts and cultural organizations rooted in communities of color, recent immigrant communities, or under-resourced populations.
opportunities.strategicFocus: Institutional stabilization, administrative capacity building, board development, and transition support toward long-term operational sustainability.
opportunities.innerSanctuaryFit: Establishes foundational institutional backing for Inner Sanctuary as a Black-founded cultural and wellness sanctuary in Southern California. Secures first-time applicant priority bonus.
opportunities.actionRequired: Submit organizational profile and 2-year capacity development roadmap focusing on somatic studio expansion.

opportunities.name: CAC Arts & Cultural Organizations General Operating Support (GOS)
opportunities.eligibility: California 501(c)(3) arts and cultural non-profits with proven public programming.
opportunities.strategicFocus: Unrestricted operational support to sustain organizational staff, teaching artists, sound healers, and community gathering space leases.
opportunities.innerSanctuaryFit: Covers essential facility overhead, facilitator compensation, and materials for weekly intention bracelet and mindfulness activations.
opportunities.actionRequired: Assemble past year event rosters (25-50 attendees/gathering) and IRS 990-N documentation.

opportunities.name: CDPH California Reducing Disparities Project (CRDP) — CDEP Grant
opportunities.funder: California Department of Public Health (CDPH) Office of Health Equity (OHE)
opportunities.cycle: Multi-Year Mental Health Services Act (Prop 63) Allocation
opportunities.eligibility: Community-Based Organizations (CBOs) implementing Community-Defined Evidence Practices (CDEPs) serving African American / Black populations.
opportunities.strategicFocus: Culturally grounded, non-clinical prevention and early intervention mental health practices designed by communities to dismantle behavioral health disparities.
opportunities.innerSanctuaryFit: Inner Sanctuary’s somatic model ("Permission to Pause", 432Hz/528Hz sound therapy, breathwork, communal witness circles) is a textbook Community-Defined Evidence Practice (CDEP) for Black nervous system restoration.
opportunities.actionRequired: Package documented somatic outcomes (50+ individual pauses, 100% substance-free circles) into the CDPH OHE CDEP demonstration framework.

opportunities.name: CDPH Community Mental Wellness & Resilience Innovation Grants
opportunities.funder: CDPH Office of Health Equity & Regional Behavioral Health
opportunities.eligibility: Southern California grassroots community health entities and 501(c)(3) public charities addressing social determinants of health (SDOH).
opportunities.strategicFocus: Upstream community healing, collective grief processing, chronic stress mitigation, and accessible holistic wellness safe spaces.
opportunities.innerSanctuaryFit: Directly validates our alcohol-free, unhurried community spaces as critical mental health preventative infrastructure in Orange County and Inland Empire.
opportunities.actionRequired: Position SoCal Creatives Collective open mics as upstream emotional wellness hubs.

opportunities.eligibility: Grassroots, Black-led and Black-serving California 501(c)(3) non-profits with annual operating budgets under $1M.

opportunities.innerSanctuaryFit: Co-Founders Teshia Campbell and Marlon Smith embody Black movement leadership prioritizing collective rest, trauma decompression, and unhurried sacred belonging.
opportunities.actionRequired: Register organizational profile on the CBFF portal; align narrative with the movement healing justice framework.

opportunities.name: CBFF Chinedu Valentine Okobi Sabbatical & Rest Program
opportunities.eligibility: Black movement and non-profit leaders, executive directors, and community visionaries dedicated to frontline community uplift.
opportunities.strategicFocus: Direct investment in deep rest, nervous system restoration, and longevity for Black changemakers to combat institutional burnout.
opportunities.innerSanctuaryFit: Directly mirrors the foundational ethos of Inner Sanctuary ("Permission to Pause"). Validates our co-founders as leaders deserving sustained wellness.
opportunities.actionRequired: Prepare leadership rest & organizational stamina portfolio for Executive Director Teshia Campbell and President Marlon Smith.
